Store a new version and queue it for indexing.

The previous version keeps answering questions until the new one is indexed.
Then the new version becomes active and the old chunks leave retrieval.

Get a conversation with its messages

post.description:
Store the visitor message and return the assistant's reply.

The reply's `answer_type` tells the UI what to show:

- `grounded`: an answer with `citations`.
- `knowledge_gap`: the documents do not answer the question; offer a human handoff.
- `clarification`: the assistant asks for more detail.
- `inquiry_offer`: the visitor wants to buy; `inquiry` may carry a draft to
  review and confirm.
post.summary: Send a visitor message and get the assistant's reply

get.description:
Report whether the database answers and which provider modes are active.

A provider with `live: false` runs in local or simulated mode. The UI must
label it and must not present it as a working LLM or a live CRM integration.

patch.description: Change a draft. A confirmed inquiry cannot be changed (409).

post.description:
Confirm a complete draft. Nothing is sent to the CRM before this call.

Returns 422 with the missing fields if the draft is incomplete. Confirming an
already confirmed inquiry returns it unchanged and never queues a second delivery.
post.summary: Confirm an inquiry and queue its delivery to the CRM

get.description: Returns 409 while the inquiry is still a draft.
get.summary: Get the delivery status of a confirmed inquiry

post.description:
Queue another delivery attempt. Returns 409 unless the delivery has failed.

A retry reuses the delivery's idempotency key, so it never creates a duplicate lead.
